column1: # Luigi's Mansion 3 on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Next Level Games' engine on SDK 7.3.2, NVN, update 1.4.0 (v327680); the two Multiplayer Pack DLC (0100DCA0064A7001, 0100DCA0064A7002: Scarescraper / ScreamPark
# rooms and costumes, nlg archives) go to aoc/. The profile is upstream's (brought up on the Mac and the iPhone), not run on an Android device yet.
# Port on 2026-11-22: 5,357 of 5,357 Vulkan shaders (5,317 split from init, the 40 more are geometry shader variants; hull / domain / geometry built too, unlike Metal),
# 588 bindings of the shadow cascades' driver-table texture array (tex_c2a). Every pixel shader's colour outputs are float, while about 1,400 of them write the
# R32Uint + RGBA8Uint G-buffer from integer bits (Metal: dmsh_build.py fs_uint): a float output into an integer attachment is undefined in Vulkan, so a pipeline with
# UINT / SINT colour targets takes the fragment shader's integer output variant (vk_spv_fragout.h, the same bits; DM_VK_INT_OUT=0 to compare). The shader preparation
# makes those parts before the game for the 1,395 pixel shaders that write integers (spv_int_writer: 1,377 from integer bits, 18 constants only; 609 with outputs 0-1,
# 784 with output 0), so a G-buffer shader's first draw compiles nothing. Not run on a device yet.
# The game's text uses its own fonts (main imports no nn::pl shared font), and it has no name entry.
